tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/src"; echo x > "$t/src/f.txt"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000; do BACKUP_STAMP=$s bash backup.sh --quiet --dest "$t/d" --name demo "$t/src" >/dev/null; done
bash rotate.sh --dest="$t/d" --name demo --keep=2 --dry-run; echo "rc=$?"
bash rotate.sh -h >/dev/null; echo "rotate -h rc=$?"
bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/d" --name demo; echo "rc=$?"
bash verify.sh --bogus 2>/dev/null; echo "unknown-flag rc=$?"; rm -rf "$t"
rm tests/smoke_flags.sh && bash tests/run_tests.sh && git status --short
tool_input.description: Remove smoke script, re-run tests, show changed files

tool_input.command: rm -f tests/smoke_flags.sh; git status --short; bash tests/run_tests.sh
tool_input.description: Delete temporary smoke script and run tests

result:
I changed `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` (bug fixes + sourcing the new shared `lib/common.sh`), added `lib/common.sh`, and added two tests to `tests/run_tests.sh` — all 10 tests pass.

Details:
- **rotate.sh**: the list is sorted oldest-first, so it was keeping the *oldest* entries (`tail -n +"$keep"`) and the `-lt` guard let `total == keep` fall through and delete the newest. Now the guard is `-le` and surplus is `head -n "$((total - keep))"` — the newest N are kept.
- **verify.sh**: the sidecar's file name is now taken as everything after the digest (`sed -E 's/^[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+//'` instead of `awk '{print $2}'`, which truncated at the first space), and the digest comparison uses quoted `[[ ]]`.
- **lib/common.sh**: contains the identical option-parsing block (`--dest/--name/--keep/-q/-n/-h/--`, `is_uint`, `need_value`, KEEP validation) plus `resolve_dir`, with a default `parse_local_option` stub; `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` source it after defining their stub. The other three scripts are untouched.

One housekeeping note: my flag smoke-check script `tests/smoke_flags.sh` is left in the working tree — `rm` needs interactive approval here, which this environment can't grant, so please delete it (it's not part of the fix).
